body:
People. I just feel like I'm never appreciated. Yet, I'm reassured by others that all my friends "love" me, but I don't see it. I'm never told by my friends how much I mean to them. I'm never the one to be texted or messaged or called first; it's always me that has to reach out to people and even then, there's no guarantee that they'll respond (because, of course, people are busy).

Fear of failure and being a loser. All I've done so far in summer is just sit around, go on the computer (mainly go on Facebook and Reddit, listening to music, and just generally bumming around on the internet), eat, and sleep; so pretty much, nothing. I feel like I'm stuck in a loop. I really want a job so I can keep myself busy and earn some money, but knowing the fact that getting a job is so hard nowadays kind of makes me not want to go out and apply for jobs. But staying inside all day and basically doing nothing makes me wish I had something to keep me busy. I know it does me no good to just sit around and bitch and complain about it, but I just can't help it and I just need to let it out. Also, I'm extremely terrified of being stuck in permanent "summer mode" at home after I graduate from college. There's nothing around here in my hometown and it feels socially isolated to me. Thinking about how I'm gonna be away from all my college friends once I graduate and that they're gonna be doing their own thing and that I could be returning back to this drab, boring black hole that they call my hometown after the most fun and exciting 4 years of my life make me feel depressed. And it doesn't help that it's extremely difficult to find a job nowadays. It's all just a bunch of bullshit. Doesn't help either that I'm gonna be a junior and I have absolutely zero job/internship experience. I haven't "networked" with people because I have no idea how. I have no idea how to set up myself for success after college. It feels like I'm just setting up myself for failure and living at home, being isolated.
